examples.text: You're going up to the front door of that mansion and ballsing your way inside.

glosses: An unbeatable hand; the best poker hand available.

examples.text: If the board is 237QA, all of spades, the nuts is 45 of spades.
If the board is 4444J, the nuts is any hand with an ace.

glosses: Crazy, mad; unusually pleased or, alternatively, angered.

examples.text: I just go nuts over her fantastic desserts.

glosses: Signifies rejection of a proposal or idea, as in forget it, no way, or nothing doing; often followed by to.

examples.text: They want me to pay $5 for a banana? Nuts to that!

glosses: An idiot, an ignorant or disagreeable person.

examples.text: Don't mind him; he's only an oul' bollocks!
The telly's bollocksed.

glosses: (also bollocks up) To fail (a task); to make a mess of.

examples.text: I bollocksed that exam.

glosses: An expression of anger, frustration, etc.

examples.text: Oh bollocks, I'm late for work!
